chip.description: PSAC2 rotate/zoom (ROZ) layer generator: a 16-bit evolution of the 051316 with 512x4 words of internal RAM allowing per-scanline rotation and zoom rather than whole-screen transforms (taxonomy §4.18 example).
chip.notes: src/devices/video/k053936.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("053936 PSAC2 ... Evolution of the 051316 ... 512x4 words of internal RAM used to control rotation and zoom scanline by scanline"). konamiic.txt annotates it "(roz+)".
